**Example material · Synthetic observations · 18 October 2026**

## A chart with a memory

An analytical result becomes easier to trust when the reader can find its query, source and capture time. Those details are part of the answer, even when they sit behind a small disclosure control.

This invented mix of query outcomes is an example of the context an operator might inspect. It is not a report about a deployed service.

```chart
type: bar
title: "Queries in an illustrative batch"
data:
  inline:
    - {category: "Complete", value: 84}
    - {category: "Empty", value: 9}
    - {category: "Unavailable", value: 7}
encoding: {x: category, y: value}
axes:
  x: {label: Category}
  y: {label: "Queries in an illustrative batch"}
```

*Source: Synthetic demonstration of 100 imaginary query receipts.*

## What to take away

A receipt belongs to one published answer: it preserves where the answer came from and when, it does not turn a saved result into a live connection, and it contains no service credentials.
